summary: Recorded a checked client-completion negative in the core: append on a non-leader forwards the entries once as ProposalForward and keeps no copy, while the scheduled resends cover only Promise/PrepareReq/Prepare/AcceptStopSign/StopSign-Decide. A lost forward or a leader failing before acceptance is therefore not re-proposed by the core; the caller's transport and application retry own that duty, and the runtime's TaggedProposal retry is a separate stronger contract. Three source anchors added, no defect claimed. All five explained findings and protection records remain unchanged.
